6.1 Sample description


Our sample consists of all firms included in the London Stock Exchange (LSE)
FTSE350 at December 31, 2006. We exclude 53 firms from this sample of 350
companies due to lack of data (see Table 1).

The average market capitalization of this sample is £4.430 bn, with a maximum
of £122 bn and a minimum of £0.211 bn (see Table 2, Panel A).

To conduct the event study, we determine which of these 297 remaining firms
